notes:
Player: audio cues on step change and the final five seconds

Three synthesised Web Audio blips — a tick for each of the last five seconds of
a step, a higher tone when the step gives way, a longer one when the routine
ends. Synthesised rather than sampled so nothing has to load and nothing is
added to the OTA bundle.

The preference is device-local: Settings is replaced wholesale by the server
copy on every /api/me, so a field there would need a migration for one boolean.
On by default, unlike the notification sound, and switchable in Réglages.
